visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal call-to-action panel: short heading or copy on the left, one or two CTAs on the right, optionally with a product image and/or a full-bleed background image

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with only a background image; then one row with cells for an optional image, the copy (heading and/or text) and the CTA links. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ page is replaced by that fragment. Background colour comes from the section style (dark, blue, grey, light-blue), not from the block

usage: Use for 'Ready to get started?' style prompts with a primary button and optional secondary link. Default renders a white card; filled lets the panel take the section colour (set the section style to dark, blue, grey or light-blue); light gives a tinted, shadowless panel. Add a picture-only first row for a background photo.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-message CTA strip. Use hero for page-top banners and columns-quick-paths for multiple parallel CTAs.
